searches.query: Alaska 2024 election night Peltola Begich lead late ballots count absentee shift
searches.finding: Begich lead 10,133 -> 9,550 (Nov 12) -> 9,434 (Nov 14); late ballots shift ~1-2 pts toward D

searches.query: Alaska 2022 general election first-choice election night vs final
searches.finding: Peltola 45% election night -> 47.3 (Nov 10) -> 48.6 (Nov 23); Murkowski overtook Tshibaka by Nov 18

searches.query: Alaska 2020 Senate election night vs final margin
searches.finding: Sullivan R+30 election night -> R+20 Nov 10; late ballots shift toward D but leader unchanged; final R+12.7
Peltola margin 5.3 on election night -> 8.1 final (49.5 vs 41.4)

searches.query: Cook Political Report / Sabato Alaska Senate
Alaska polls underestimate Republicans 2024 Peltola Begich poll miss; 2020 Sullivan polls vs result
searches.finding: 2020 Sullivan outperformed polls by ~8 pts; 2024 polls roughly right; Alaska polling thin and error-prone
searches.tests: the assumption that the +2 poll lead and D-leaning late ballots translate to Peltola leading, i.e. that Alaska polls are not biased against Republicans

searches.query: Alaska Beacon / Alaska Public early voting Republicans share and late ballots expected
searches.finding: Republicans lead early vote share but D overrepresented vs registration; no analyst claims late ballots will favour R

searches.query: Alaska 2026 general counting schedule Nov 13 mail receipt deadline
searches.finding: Domestic mail ballots must arrive by Nov 13; Nov 13 snapshot includes most but not all late ballots; RCV Nov 18

searches.query: Newsweek Peltola pulling ahead final stretch
searches.finding: Polls Peltola +2 to +7; Ivan Moore says opinion stable
